why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 66's east edge prints 'AVENUE R 1/2' (sheet 48 beyond); the block against it carries the even R 1/2 frontage 3102-3128 and street numbers 2313-2324, while the 23xx run continues west to Avenue R (separately labelled 'AVENUE R.') with 2301-2312. Sheet 74's west side prints 'AVENUE R 1/2' with the odd frontage 3401-3427 immediately east and street numbers 2401-2412 / 2413-2424; west of it sheet 74 still shows 2317-2324 on the 3402-3428 face, the same block sheet 66 draws. The 2300/2400 hundred-block change is therefore at Avenue R 1/2, not at Avenue R or Avenue S. Corridor width printed 80'.
